validation_notes: The right side of the chart (late Jul 27 to Aug 3) shows price consolidating in a fairly flat, range-bound channel between ~0.0405 and ~0.0435, not a converging triangle. There's no clear descending upper trendline of lower highs squeezing into a flat support - highs and lows are both roughly horizontal, forming more of a rectangle/consolidation box than a descending triangle. The one large upper wick spike (around Jul 30) is an outlier, not part of a resistance trendline. Prior to this consolidation, there was a clear downtrend from ~0.05 to ~0.042, which is the dominant structure, not a triangle. I don't see convincing convergence (narrowing range) near the apex on the right edge - the last dozen candles show similar range width throughout, suggesting sideways chop rather than compression toward a breakout point.
